statement:
The record shows a recently changed bank account holder name (K. Lindqvist) that does not match the employee’s name (J. Okafor), and the account was last changed 14 months ago (unusually long for a recent change). I will **hold** the payment to verify the account details.
Payment for employee **E-2044 (J. Okafor)** is **held** due to a mismatch in the account holder name. The employee must confirm the bank details before the pay can be released.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts a specific defect — "a mismatch in the account holder name" (K. Lindqvist vs J. Okafor) plus the contradictory change dates — and holds the payment on that basis.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
